name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes: v1.3.0 — Cascade aggregation parent ← child + Forbid direct work-item logging on container issues. Two new self-contained workflow rules in the YT-app root: (1) workflow-cascade-aggregation.js sums per-role plan/fact fields (derived from the existing DTA Fields → Estimate/Fact mapping) from child issues into level-2 (story-like) and level-3 (epic-like) parents along the configured parent link; max 2 hierarchy levels. (2) workflow-forbid-container.js rejects any save that adds or edits a work item on a level-2/level-3 container issue, ensuring time logging happens only on leaf children. New settings block «Cascade aggregation of work hours» exposes 7 controls: cascade-on toggle, forbid-on toggle, configurable kind-field name (default «Type»), comma-separated level-2 / level-3 value lists (defaults «Story» / «Epic»), and parent-link inward / outward names (defaults match the built-in YouTrack «Subtask» link). A live UI warning highlights the dangerous combination cascade-on + forbid-off without blocking save. All workflow strings and UI labels are localised across all 15 languages with EN fallback. See CHANGELOG.md.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
